paragraphs: LIST OF STUDENT RESOURCES: AT A GLANCE
YOUR CORE CAMPUS RESOURCES
Clyde’s Cupboard  •  Kraemer Family Library  •  Excel Tutoring Centers  •  Wellness & Recreation Center  •  Student Life  • Professional Development and Career Services
Most support starts with your UCCS student account, ID, or a visit to the listed department. Some services have eligibility, availability, or cost limits.
Basic Needs & Financial Support
•  Clyde’s Cupboard: free food pantry with weekly 10 item limit and everyday essentials.
•  Clyde’s Closet: 7 free professional clothing and items each semester.
•  Mountain Lion Meals: complimentary dining meals for eligible students up to 3 a week.
•  Basic Needs / Single Stop: benefits screening, support and limited emergency financial assistance.
•  Wellness Center, MOSAIC Center: personal care items, welcoming lounge and community resources.
Academic Support & Library
•  Kraemer Family Library (KFL): study rooms, books, textbook reserves, journal databases, reflection room, and research help.
•  Excel Centers: free science, math, writing and presentation support with snacks and personalized support.
•  Academic Advising: course planning, registration and degree progress.
•  TRIO / Disability Services: eligible student guidance and academic accommodations.
Health, Counseling & Wellness
•  Wellness Center: counseling, medical care, nutrition and health coaching; some fees apply.
•  TELUS Health Student Support: 24/7 mental health chat support through the student mobile app.
•  Gallogly Rec Center: fitness facilities and recreation programming.
•  PEAK Wellness Boxes / Canine Connections: wellness supplies and stress-relief events.
UCCS Farm & Greenhouse: year-round free herbs, seasonal produce and eggs, friendly animal interaction, home to GAF for extensive types of grant funding, learning and wellness events.
Student Life, Community & Belonging
•  Student Life & Club Match: find organizations, events, workshops, and student communities.
•  First2Go / MOSAIC Mentorship: peer connections and support for eligible students.
•  Clyde’s Five / UCCSlead: engagement and leadership opportunities.
•  Campus Events: welcome-week programs, DeStress Fest, Homecoming, seasonal events, club fairs and giveaways.
Technology, Software & Career
•  Microsoft 365 / Zoom / ChatGPT Edu: UCCS-provided productivity and learning tools.
•  Virtual Lab / OIT Software Catalog: access campus-licensed software and IT services.
•  LinkedIn Learning / Coursera: online courses and professional skill building.
•  Laptop Program / IT Support: device lending and assistance. Cords, stationary lending and more at the KFL.
•  Career Center: résumés, cover letters support, interviews and internship guidance.
•  Handshake / Big Interview / Forage / career events, career relevant learning, and interview practice.
Transportation & Safety
•  500-Series Parking: Free Student Permit; vehicle registration required.
•  Mountain Metro Bus Passes: student passes that give bus access extending beyond campus to the broader CO Springs area.
•  Campus Shuttle: transportation between campus stops.
•  UCCS Safe App / Police Escorts: school alerts and safety assistance.
MORE TO EXPLORE: PPLD library perks, student discounts, research funding, education abroad, arts, community events and much more in the full resource list.
Please find current details by searching each resource name or contacting the UCCS department. Offerings may change.  •  Source: Comprehensive UCCS Student Resource List (October 2026)
